Sac County Pheasants Forever Youth Hunt

Sac County Pheasants Forever Youth Hunt
Kiowa Marsh
2397 230th st
Early, IA
Map to Event
--> October 24, 2026
--> 7:00 am · 1:00pm
--> Cost: Free (11+)
Sac County Chapter of Pheasants Forever is putting on a Pheasant Youth Hunt for youth, ages 11-15, with a completed hunter safety education. This event will begin at the Iowa Department of Natural Resource building located outside of Early, Iowa. (2392 230th St, Early, IA) From there, we will go to public hunting accesses and pheasant hunt from 8-10AM. After the hunt we will come back and shoot clay pigeons. A light breakfast will be served starting at 7AM and we will finish the day with a pizza party. There will be give aways for all youth who attend. One lucky winner will even go home with a new shotgun!
Youth must bring their own guns. Ammunition will be provided. Please dress appropriately for the hunt. A waiver of liability must be signed prior to attending. A parent/guardian is strongly encouraged to attend.
This event is pre-register only by calling or texting Paige Struchen at 712-292-0915, or private messaging the Sac County Chapter of Pheasants Forever Facebook page. Must register by October 15, 2025. Event is limited to the first 15 youth.
Information needed at the time of registering: child’s name, parent/guardian name if attending, caliber of gun they will be bringing, a copy of their hunter safety certificate, and signed waiver of liability form.
For More Information
Contact: Paige Struchen
(712) 292-0915

About Our County
Established in 1846, Sac County is a collection of 9 communities and home to nearly 9,000 residents. The county is named for the Sauk people, a local Native American tribe. Sac County is administered by a three-member Board of Supervisors who are elected for four-year terms. Other elected officials include the Attorney , Auditor , Recorder , Sheriff , and Treasurer .
